# Composition

## Rules

### CodeGraphProvider facade
- Top-level API with explicit lifecycle (open()/close()).
- Index: index(options) -> IndexCodeGraph; owns force-reset/lock internally.
- Query & Search: getSymbol, findSymbols, getFile, getDocument, getSpec, searchSymbols/searchSpecs/searchDocuments, unified multi-category search operation across symbols|files|specs|documents with single query plan, occurrence suppression, and post-grouping category limits.
- Traversal & Impact: getUpstream, getDownstream, analyzeImpact, analyzeFileImpact, analyzeFilesImpact, analyzeSpecImpact, detectChanges, getHotspots.
- Selectors & Symbol References: resolveFileSelector, resolveSymbolSelector, single/batch symbol-reference resolution, exact public-binding lookup (surface, name, symbol space, canonical target), canonical symbol & public-binding impact.
- Maintenance: clear().
- Public MUST NOT depend on recreate() or exposed lock helpers.

### Factory function
- Primary: createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CodeGraphCompositionOptions): CodeGraphProvider.
  - Storage root from config.configPath. Backend: options.graphStoreId or built-in default (sqlite). Overload detects via SpecdConfig shape.
  - Registers built-ins (ladybug, sqlite) + custom graphStoreFactories & adapters.
- Legacy: createCodeGraphProvider(options: CodeGraphOptions) with storagePath.
- CodeGraphProvider type-only on "."; internals on "./internal". Construct ONLY via factory.

### Package exports
- "." (from src/public.ts): composition types/factories, host use cases, VCS/config helpers, indexer public types, traversal/impact, hotspots, search expanders/multi-category search types, staleness/fingerprint, LanguageAdapter, model vocab, error subclasses, CODE_GRAPH_VERSION, symbol-reference/resolver types.
- "./internal" (from src/index.ts): indexer internals, InMemoryIndexSession, concrete store adapter symbols, locks, recreate helpers.

### Host use cases
- GetGraphHealth, IndexProjectGraph, GetSpecCoverage, GetChangeSpecCoverage receive already-open provider.

### Lifecycle management
- MUST open() before query/traversal/index unless managed by helper. open() = async boundary. close() idempotent. No auto-open/auto-close.

### Dependency on @specd/core
- Runtime dep for SpecdConfig/SpecdWorkspaceConfig & metadata parsing.

## Constraints
- Sole construction path: createCodeGraphProvider.
- Backend selection registry-driven, not specd.yaml.
- 1 active GraphStore per construction.
- Facade delegates to domain services; holds no domain logic.
- Indexing locks + destructive recreate remain internal.
